notes: Radiofrequency fermionic interferometer using NiZn ferrimagnet (electron spins), searching for axion-electron interaction. The paper reports limits on the pseudoscalar coupling g_p, with minimum |g_p| = 1.2e-7 at m_a ~ 0.36 neV. Since the sensing material relies on electron spin resonance, this constrains the axion-electron coupling. The exclusion plot (Fig. 5) spans roughly 1e-11 to 1e-8 eV with |g_p| on the y-axis; only the single quoted minimum value is given numerically in text. The y-axis is labeled |g_p| (generic pseudoscalar coupling) rather than specifically g_ae, hence reduced confidence.
